pages.text: The crafted frame can be broken by using $(l:utility/netherite_auto_pruner)Netherite Pruner$(), when has enchants '$(6)Silk Touch$()' and '$(6)Channeling$()'. This will not works with portal located in the$(br)

$(br)Stronghold.$(br2)If the frame had an Ender Eye, it will also drop out.$(br2)Eye can also be extracted by using shears with the mentioned enchants (works on vanilla portal).$(br2) In any case, the portal will be disabled$(br)
